title: A Echo for the Archive
author: Petra Coldharbour
blurb: Paloma Coldharbour, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the fleet's truce expires.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
